check_service_status.description: Check whether the Coffee API is answering, how quickly, and how much of the rate limit is left. This is the one action that reports a problem as a value instead of failing the step, so a workflow can decide what to do about it. Being throttled is reported separately from being down.

get_drink.description: Look up one drink and get its description, what goes into it, and a photo. Pick it from the list, or pass a name or a drink id in from an earlier step: an id costs one small request, and a name is matched against the menu, so 'cold brew' finds Cold Brew and a name that fits two drinks comes back saying which rather than guessing between them.

get_drink_of_the_day.description: Pick one drink for a day and keep picking that same drink all day. A random pick gives a different one on every call, so a daily workflow that retries, or that two people run an hour apart, posts two different drinks for the one day. This one is fixed by the date: the same date always gives the same drink, and tomorrow gives a different one. Add a seed of your own to have two workspaces post different drinks on the same day.

parameters.description: Only keep drinks built on this. The menu is not all coffee (it also carries tea, hot chocolate, orange juice and lemonade), and the service records no such field, so this is read off each recipe: espresso or coffee makes it a coffee, tea or matcha a tea, chocolate or cocoa a chocolate. A mocha counts as a coffee. Leave empty for the whole menu.
parameters.name: base

parameters.description: Only keep drinks that are, or are not, served over ice. Taken from the recipe rather than from which of the service's two lists a drink is filed under, because that filing is wrong for a sixth of the menu: Iced Latte and Frozen Lemonade both sit on its 'hot' list. Leave empty for both.
parameters.name: ice

parameters.description: Any text you like. Two runs given the same seed pick the same drink, which is what a test, a screenshot or a step that retries needs. Leave empty for a genuinely different drink each time.

list_drinks.description: Browse the whole menu, or just the part of it you want: search the names, recipes and descriptions for a word, keep only the coffees or only the teas, only the ones served over ice, only the ones containing particular ingredients, and order what is left. The service offers no search, no filter and no ordering that reaches across both of its lists, so both are read once and merged here, which is what lets all of that be one step. The number of drinks matching is always reported, however many are returned.

list_ingredients.description: List everything the menu is made of, with the drinks that use each thing and whether every one of them treats it as optional. The service publishes recipes but no ingredient list, so this is gathered from the menu: it is what a café would order, or what a 'can we make this?' step checks against. Sugar and Sugar* are counted as the one ingredient they are.

description: Look up coffee-shop drinks (the description, the recipe and a photo for each) from the free, keyless Coffee API. Get one drink by name, search the menu by word, ingredient or style, pick one at random for a "what should I order?" post, or pick a drink of the day that stays the same all day so a scheduled post never names two. It also totals up what the whole menu is made of, ingredient by ingredient. The service files its drinks across two lists that do not mean what they are called, so whether a drink is iced and what it is built on are read off the recipe here instead, and the practice rows people have left in this public sandbox are kept off the menu.
